Chinese scientists genetically modify human embryos
As someone not very familiar with the matter, why did it take so long from the Dolly sheep to this? Wasn't modifying DNA just a little step further than cloning it?

Scientists have been doing genomic modification for a long time. The organisms that we have been doing it on and always been not humans, e.g. sheep, bacteria or plants.The interesting thing here is that the China is modifying human embryos. This is the ethical shift that is occurring. Everyone knew it was possible to edit human genomes, the second any complex genome could be edited then any other complex organisms could also be edited. The ground breaking thing here is that we are now in the age where we might start genomically selecting traits. People are concerned for the potential to start making 'designer babies.' Since the world is so connected, the lowest ethical denominator has a lot of influence in this field of study.

So the whole special thing about this they are using humans and not pigs, not a technical reason? In this case it makes sense Chana makes a first step, since concerned people which did not grow up knowing this is going to happen have less chance to change regulations.

Duel Wielding Mechanics

You will be able to set your main hand, as stated by This tweet.

  • The change appears for other players, as well as yourself.

A tweet showing how using items will work with duel wielding.

  • The images themselves.

  • Swords no longer have an effect when you right click.

  • With a sword in you main hand, and an item in your off hand, left clicking swings the sword, and right clicking uses the item.

  • If you have two consumables in your hands (the image used torches in the main hand and enderpearls in the off hand), right clicking will try to place a torch. Presumably the enderpearl can't be used with a usable item in your main hand.

  • If you have two swords in your hands, left clicking will swing your main-hand sword. Right clicking will not do anything, as swords no longer have a secondary use.

  • If the item in your main hand can't be used (no blocks close enough to place) you will use your offhand item. for example, if you have a torch and pearl in your hands, and there isn't a block close enough to place it when you right click, you will throw the pearl.
